description: Land Title Settlement Department - Maththumagala, Wattala D/S Division, Gampaha District - Cad. Map No. 512011
categorisation: This gazette content deals exclusively with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act, specifically declaring determinations of land titles for multiple parcels in the Wattala area. It contains detailed schedules of land parcels with ownership details, extents, and encumbrances, falling squarely within the Land Gazette category (Type 4) for land and property-related matters.
